title: AWARE 2.0 Phase 5 R4 — c8 test coverage harness + ≥80% gate (ADR-020 deliverable)
what_shipped: .nycrc.json (new file, c8 config — v2 source paths only)

config_design.rationale: ADR-020 says 'coverage ≥80% on new code'. 'New code' = v2 code (ADR-020 596-684). v1 code is shipped and out of scope.

bringup_smokes.8h_harness_sanity: runs c8 on test/unit/budget/watchdog.test.js alone, asserts lcov.info exists with >= 1 end_of_record block. Fast (~200ms). Always runs in default bring-up.
bringup_smokes.8i_gate_enforcement: runs full `npm run coverage:text`, parses 'All files | % Stmts | % Branch | % Funcs | % Lines', asserts % Lines >= 80. Opt-in via BRINGUP_FULL=1.
